title: Optimal Service Commitments in Traveling Salesman Problems with Stochastic Demand
summary: In ridepooling services, mobility providers must communicate an expected arrival time before customers decide whether to book. An ambitious commitment attracts higher demand than a conservative one, but is correspondingly harder to fulfill. Provider revenue is therefore governed by an endogenous interplay between the announced commitment and the demand it induces.
